entities.title: Kong Climb
entities.summary: A recreation of the 1981 arcade climber for the browser, desktop and phone: dodge an ape's barrels, pies, springs and fireballs across four stages and reach the captive. It keeps the original's rules and feel and draws everything itself.
entities.purpose: Holds the whole game: the rules engine in src/engine, the canvas page, sound and input in src/client, the page and stylesheet in public/, the Worker that serves them to invited players in worker/, and the tests in test/. It is one npm project and one Cloudflare Worker, and is listed in the Recreations group on icelander.net/games.
boundaries: The sign-in is icelander.net's; the Worker checks it with the shared library in vendor/icelander-auth/, never edited here, and serves nothing to a player without the invite-only role games:recreations.
The game runs wholly in the browser: no server state, no high-score table (the best score is kept in the browser's localStorage). Nothing is loaded from outside the origin.
Sprites, sounds, stage layouts, names and text are written for this game. Only the rules and the feel of the original are kept.
